## What changes for you

- Find Markdown files by file name or relative path in each Markdown Source, and by Markdown Source display name in All Markdown Sources. Names that look the same but use different Unicode forms now match consistently, and All Markdown Sources can move the most relevant source sections ahead while filtering.
- Open an empty Markdown Source folder directly and get specific recovery guidance when a source cannot be loaded, a preview cannot be read, or a copy action fails.
- Preview truncation now preserves complete Unicode characters and explicitly indicates when content has been shortened.
- Copy Expanded Content now reports a failure instead of reporting success when `{clipboard}` cannot be read.
- Markdown Source folders configured through symbolic links are no longer accepted; MdClip now requires the actual folder.

## Install or update

- MdClip v0.3.0 requires Node.js `>=22.22.2` and npm `>=11.17.0`. Confirm `node -v` and `npm -v` satisfy these requirements before running `npm ci`.
- For a normal update, keep MdClip in Raycast, stop any old `npm run dev` process, replace only the old `mdclip` source folder with `Source code (zip)` from this release, then run `npm ci` and `npm run dev` in the new folder. Keep the folders configured as Markdown Sources unchanged. Follow the [English update guide](https://github.com/uchimanajet7/mdclip/blob/v0.3.0/docs/getting-started.md#8-update-mdclip) or [Japanese update guide](https://github.com/uchimanajet7/mdclip/blob/v0.3.0/docs/getting-started.ja.md#8-%E6%9B%B4%E6%96%B0%E3%81%99%E3%82%8B).
- If a Markdown Source uses a symbolic link, select the actual target folder in Raycast Extension Preferences after updating.
